comment: The bribe of the turnkey in the chapel of Gruvhald (D-1334, D-1335, D-1354). A talk with the turnkey plays it until the party pays. The pay step asks for 40 gold. A yes with enough gold removes the gold and turns on the flag that opens the stair door, and a yes with too little gold, or a no, shows the refusal and ends the scene, so the next talk asks again.
